sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，您可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用中本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: In late April 1972, a serious matter was unravelling at the Westfriedhof Mortuary in Nuremberg, Germany.
sentences.zh: 1972年4月下旬，德国纽伦堡的西公墓殡仪馆发生了一件严重的事情。

sentences.en: Several relatives of the recently deceased had noticed a jewellery missing from their loved ones' bodies.
sentences.zh: 几位刚去世者的亲属注意到，他们亲人的遗体上少了珠宝。

sentences.en: The cadavers had been stored in the facility's crematorium prior to burial, where, at some point, the jewellery would vanish.
sentences.zh: 尸体在下葬前会被存放在殡仪馆的火葬场，而珠宝就在某个时间点不翼而飞了。

sentences.en: The bereaved expressed their concerns to the mortuary's night watchman,
sentences.zh: 悲痛的家属向殡仪馆的夜班守卫表达了他们的担忧，

sentences.en: 47-year-old Georg Varmut.
sentences.zh: 那名守卫是47岁的格奥尔格·瓦穆特。

sentences.en: Complaints like these weren't unusual.
sentences.zh: 这类投诉并不罕见。

sentences.en: The missing items would usually be found at the home of the deceased, having never been on their body in the first place.
sentences.zh: 失踪的物品通常会在死者家中找到，因为它们根本就没被带到殡仪馆。

sentences.en: Other times, mortuary staff would remove the high-value items and store them in a small chest for safekeeping.
sentences.zh: 有时，殡仪馆工作人员会取下贵重物品，存放在小箱子里妥善保管。

sentences.en: It was only a matter of time before they reappeared.
sentences.zh: 这些东西重现只是时间问题。

sentences.en: This time, however, Georg was beginning to suspect something was amiss.
sentences.zh: 然而这一次，格奥尔格开始怀疑事情不对劲。

sentences.en: Upon entering the mortuary's waiting room one day, Georg found a money box displaced on a table.
sentences.zh: 一天，格奥尔格走进殡仪馆候诊室时，发现桌上的钱箱被挪动了位置。

sentences.en: It had been forced open and emptied.
sentences.zh: 它被人强行撬开并洗劫一空。

sentences.en: Finding no evidence of a break-in, Georg believed that the culprit was likely someone who worked at the mortuary or the adjoining Nuremberg West Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 由于没有发现闯入的痕迹，格奥尔格认为罪魁祸首很可能是殡仪馆或相邻的纽伦堡西公墓的工作人员。

sentences.en: To avoid causing tension amongst his colleagues or tarnishing the reputation of his workplace,
sentences.zh: 为了避免同事间产生紧张关系，也不想损害工作场所的声誉，

sentences.en: Georg kept his suspicions to himself.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格把怀疑藏在了心里。

sentences.en: He began investigating the matter discreetly, with the intention to confront the perpetrator once he had identified them.
sentences.zh: 他开始秘密调查此事，打算在查明真相后与肇事者当面对质。

sentences.en: A six-foot-tall, burly war veteran, Georg felt more than capable of handling any ensuing conflict.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格是一位身高六英尺、身材魁梧的退伍军人，他觉得自己完全有能力处理随之而来的冲突。

sentences.en: The following days were uneventful.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天风平浪静。

sentences.en: Then a storm rolled in on the night of May 5.
sentences.zh: 直到5月5日夜里，一场风暴来袭。

sentences.en: Georg Warmut took shelter at his home next to the mortuary.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格·瓦穆特躲在殡仪馆旁的家中避雨。

sentences.en: He was watching television and thinking over the recent spate of thefts when the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 他正看着电视，思考着最近发生的一连串盗窃案，这时电话响了。

sentences.en: On the other line was one of his neighbours, a woman who lived opposite the cemetery.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是他的邻居，一位住在公墓对面的女士。

sentences.en: She reported seeing a dark figure moving quickly between the graves.
sentences.zh: 她报告说看到一个黑影在墓地间快速移动。

sentences.en: Suspecting it was the thief, Georg rushed to the mortuary.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格怀疑那是小偷，便冲向了殡仪馆。

sentences.en: He hid patiently in the darkness on the mezzanine floor, waiting for the thief to appear.
sentences.zh: 他耐心地躲在夹层的黑暗中，等待小偷出现。

sentences.en: When they failed to do so, Georg sought them out.
sentences.zh: 当对方迟迟未现身时，格奥尔格主动展开了搜寻。

sentences.en: His search led him to the crematorium.
sentences.zh: 搜寻将他引向了火葬场。

sentences.en: Georg turned out the lights and waited in the shadows.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格关掉灯，躲在阴影中等待。

sentences.en: He heard the door creak open.
sentences.zh: 他听到了门吱呀一声打开的声音。

sentences.en: A slim, short-statured man with the jet-black hair entered the secure area and slowly made his way to a nearby coffin.
sentences.zh: 一个身材瘦小、留着乌黑头发的男人进入了安保区域，慢慢走向附近的一具棺材。

sentences.en: It contained the body of a 15-year-old girl who had arrived the previous day.
sentences.zh: 里面装着一名昨天刚送来的15岁女孩的遗体。

sentences.en: Georg watched as the intruder leant into the coffin.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格注视着入侵者俯身探入棺材。

sentences.en: And kissed the corpse on the lips.
sentences.zh: 并亲吻了尸体的嘴唇。

sentences.en: This was one of many disturbing incidents that had occurred at a German mortuary or cemetery in recent times.
sentences.zh: 这是近期在德国殡仪馆或公墓发生的众多令人不安的事件之一。

sentences.en: A year earlier, on April 14, 1971, a staff member at the Ulsdorf Cemetery in Hamburg entered the mortuary and stumbled across a horrific scene.
sentences.zh: 一年前，即1971年4月14日，汉堡乌尔斯多夫公墓的一名工作人员进入殡仪馆时，偶然发现了一幕恐怖场景。

sentences.en: The body of a girl had been removed from her coffin and posed so that she was leaning against it.
sentences.zh: 一名女孩的遗体被从棺材中移出，并被摆成靠在棺材上的姿势。

sentences.en: She was naked and her lips and neck were bruised with visible bite marks.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，嘴唇和脖子上有明显的淤青和咬痕。

sentences.en: Placed beside her were two burnt-out candles.
sentences.zh: 在她身边放着两根燃尽的蜡烛。

sentences.en: She was surrounded by the bodies of other corpses that had also been removed from their coffins.
sentences.zh: 她周围环绕着其他同样被从棺材中移出的尸体。

sentences.en: They were sitting up, facing the girl.
sentences.zh: 它们坐着，面对着那个女孩。

sentences.en: Three days later, 64 kilometres east of Hamburg, an undertaker was met by a similar scene when he walked into his parlour.
sentences.zh: 三天后，在汉堡以东64公里处，一名殡葬承办人走进自己的殡仪馆时，也遇到了类似的场景。

sentences.en: The body of a recently deceased 40-year-old woman was sitting up outside of her coffin, surrounded by burnt-out candles.
sentences.zh: 一名刚去世的40岁女性的遗体坐在棺材外，周围环绕着燃尽的蜡烛。

sentences.en: Then, on the island of Silt in the North Sea, a pastor headed over to his church.
sentences.zh: 随后，在北海的叙尔特岛上，一位牧师前往他的教堂。

sentences.en: The body of a 52-year-old man was lying in a coffin inside, ready to be laid to reSt.
sentences.zh: 里面的一具棺材里躺着一名52岁男子的遗体，准备安葬。

sentences.en: The pastor had made sure the coffin was closed when he left the previous evening.
sentences.zh: 牧师前一天晚上离开时，确认过棺材是合上的。

sentences.en: But, as he entered the church that day, the lid was open.
sentences.zh: 但当他那天进入教堂时，棺盖却是开着的。

sentences.en: Worse still, protruding from the man's chest was a hunting knife.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，那男子的胸口插着一把猎刀。

sentences.en: In May, a woman named Marion was walking through the Moorland Cemetery in the town of Flensburg.
sentences.zh: 五月，一名叫玛丽昂的女子走过弗伦斯堡镇的荒原公墓。

sentences.en: As she drew closer to her mother's burial plot, she noticed someone sitting on the adjoining gravesite.
sentences.zh: 当她走近母亲的墓地时，注意到有人坐在相邻的坟墓上。

sentences.en: Marion was shocked to realise that the grave had been dug up.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂震惊地发现那座坟墓被人挖开了。

sentences.en: The person sitting was the body of the man who'd been buried there.
sentences.zh: 坐在那儿的正是被埋在那里的男子的遗体。

sentences.en: He had been decapitated, and his head was missing.
sentences.zh: 他遭到了斩首，头颅不见了。

sentences.en: Months later, on November 6, a man was visiting a cemetery in Foyt to pay his respects to a deceased relative.
sentences.zh: 几个月后的11月6日，一名男子前往福伊特的公墓祭奠已故亲人。

sentences.en: While walking through the grounds, he spotted a grave that had been dug up.
sentences.zh: 在走过墓地时，他发现了一座被挖开的坟墓。

sentences.en: The coffin within had been prized open, and the naked body of a young girl was sitting upright on the mound of dirt.
sentences.zh: 里面的棺材被撬开了，一名年轻女孩的赤裸遗体正坐在土堆上。

sentences.en: When Westfriedhof Mortuary Night Watchman Georg Varmut came across the intruder kissing the corpse, he immediately leapt into action.
sentences.zh: 当西公墓殡仪馆的夜班守卫格奥尔格·瓦穆特撞见入侵者亲吻尸体时，他立即采取了行动。

sentences.en: The perpetrator, realising he'd been caught in the act, made a break for the exit.
sentences.zh: 肇事者意识到自己被当场抓获，便向出口逃窜。

sentences.en: Georg chased after him, grabbing him by the collar as he reached the door.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格紧追不舍，在对方到达门口时抓住了他的衣领。

sentences.en: He pulled the man into a nearby elevator, where the diffused light illuminated the man's face.
sentences.zh: 他把那人拉进附近的电梯，昏暗的灯光照亮了那人的脸。

sentences.en: He was a strange-looking individual aged in his thirties, with spectacles and a bulbous nose.
sentences.zh: 那是一个长相怪异的三十多岁男子，戴着眼镜，长着一个球状的鼻子。

sentences.en: He didn't utter a word.
sentences.zh: 他一言不发。

sentences.en: A loud bang interrupted the pair's altercation as Georg was hit by a painful blow.
sentences.zh: 一声巨响打断了二人的扭打，格奥尔格感到一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: Blood seeped from his upper abdomen into his shirt.
sentences.zh: 鲜血从他的上腹部渗出，染红了衬衫。

sentences.en: He let go of the intruder, who was holding a smoking 7.65mm pistol, and fell to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他松开了那名手持冒烟的7.65毫米手枪的入侵者，倒在地上。

sentences.en: The gunman grinned at the wounded Georg before taking off.
sentences.zh: 枪手对着受伤的格奥尔格咧嘴一笑，随后逃之夭夭。

sentences.en: Georg crawled on all fours to the telephone in his office.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格四肢着地爬向办公室的电话。

sentences.en: He called emergency services, then dragged himself to the bathroom to tend to his injury.
sentences.zh: 他拨打了急救电话，然后拖着身体爬进洗手间处理伤口。

sentences.en: The bullet had damaged his small and large intestines as well as his bladder, but Georg survived.
sentences.zh: 子弹损伤了他的小肠、大肠以及膀胱，但格奥尔格活了下来。

sentences.en: Police arrived and sealed off the mortuary, but the gunman was long gone.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到并封锁了殡仪馆，但枪手早已逃之夭夭。

sentences.en: Georg was able to provide a detailed description of his assailant.
sentences.zh: 格奥尔格详细描述了袭击者的外貌。

sentences.en: By the following day, 50 detectives were chasing up the alibis of known grave diggers, robbers, thieves, and other criminals in the area.
sentences.zh: 第二天，50名侦探开始核查当地已知掘墓人、强盗、小偷和其他罪犯的不在场证明。

sentences.en: All of them were accounted for.
sentences.zh: 所有人都排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: When 24-year-old Marcus Adler met 19-year-old Ruth Lissi, it was love at first sight.
sentences.zh: 当24岁的马库斯·阿德勒遇到19岁的露丝·利西时，他们一见钟情。

sentences.en: The pair met three years earlier in Yugoslavia and had been inseparable since.
sentences.zh: 两人三年前在南斯拉夫相识，此后便形影不离。

sentences.en: Marcus and his mother ran a freight business in Uberhausen, while Ruth was employed as a salesperson more than 470km away in Nuremberg.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和他的母亲在奥伯豪森经营一家货运公司，而露丝则在470多公里外的纽伦堡担任销售员。

sentences.en: Every chance that he got, Marcus drove the long journey in his light grey Mercedes to visit Ruth.
sentences.zh: 马库斯一有机会，就会开着他那辆浅灰色奔驰车长途跋涉去探望露丝。

sentences.en: On May 6, Marcus set out for the home where Ruth lived with her parents.
sentences.zh: 5月6日，马库斯出发前往露丝与父母同住的家。

sentences.en: After he arrived, the two decided to go for a drive together.
sentences.zh: 他到达后，两人决定一起开车出去兜风。

sentences.en: They farewelled Ruth's mother at 6pm and left in Marcus' car.
sentences.zh: 他们在下午6点向露丝的母亲告别，坐着马库斯的车离开了。

sentences.en: The young couple headed to a forest east of Nuremberg, a short drive from Ruth's home.
sentences.zh: 这对年轻情侣前往纽伦堡以东的一片森林，距离露丝家车程很短。

sentences.en: After finding a scenic spot to park, the two dozed off, with Marcus in the front seat and Ruth lying in the back.
sentences.zh: 找到一个风景优美的停车点后，两人睡着了，马库斯在前座，露丝躺在后座。

sentences.en: Nearby, a short, bespectacled man drove through the forest on his red moped.
sentences.zh: 附近，一名身材矮小、戴着眼镜的男子骑着红色轻便摩托车穿过森林。

sentences.en: It was the perfect place for him to lay low until the heat of the Westfriedhof mortuary shooting dissipated.
sentences.zh: 这是他躲避风头、等待西公墓枪击案热度消退的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: He had spent the day exploring the wilderness, where he carried out target practice.
sentences.zh: 他花了一整天时间在荒野中探索，并进行了射击练习。

sentences.en: This particular forest was popular with hunters, so the sound of his shooting at traffic signs, trees and the occasional deer didn't attract any unwanted attention.
sentences.zh: 这片森林是猎人们常去的地方，所以他射击交通标志、树木和偶尔出现的鹿所发出的声音，并没有引起任何不必要的注意。

sentences.en: The man was still there at dusk, riding around aimlessly, when he spotted the light grey Mercedes with the sleeping couple inside.
sentences.zh: 黄昏时分，那人还在那里漫无目的地骑行，这时他发现了那辆停着熟睡情侣的浅灰色奔驰车。

sentences.en: He pulled over and cautiously approached the car.
sentences.zh: 他靠边停车，谨慎地靠近汽车。

sentences.en: He reached over and opened the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 他伸手打开了驾驶座一侧的车门。

sentences.en: The noise woke Marcus, prompting the man to pull out his 7.65mm pistol.
sentences.zh: 响声惊醒了马库斯，促使那人掏出了他的7.65毫米手枪。

sentences.en: He shot Marcus in the head, causing Ruth to sit up abruptly.
sentences.zh: 他朝马库斯的头部开了一枪，导致露丝猛地坐了起来。

sentences.en: The man shifted his attention to her, shooting her in the left side of her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 那人将注意力转向她，朝她的左胸开了一枪。

sentences.en: He then leaned into the car and shot both of them execution style, to make certain they were dead.
sentences.zh: 随后，他探身进车，以行刑式手法又补了几枪，确保他们已经死亡。

sentences.en: Overwhelmed with impulse, the man climbed into the car and pressed his lips to Marcus's wounds, sucking the blood from them.
sentences.zh: 在冲动的驱使下，那人爬进车里，将嘴唇贴在马库斯的伤口上，吮吸着流出的血液。

sentences.en: Once he'd had enough, he clambered into the back seat.
sentences.zh: 过足瘾后，他爬到了后座。

sentences.en: He tore Ruth's sweater off, pushed up her bra, then licked the blood from her chest wound.
sentences.zh: 他扯掉露丝的毛衣，推起她的胸罩，然后舔舐她胸口伤口处的血迹。

sentences.en: After 10 minutes, he was overcome with a calming sense of satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 10分钟后，他感到一种平静的满足感。

sentences.en: He felt stronger than before.
sentences.zh: 他觉得比以前更有力量了。

sentences.en: The man pulled off Ruth's engagement ring and rummaged through her purse.
sentences.zh: 那人摘下露丝的订婚戒指，并在她的钱包里翻找。

sentences.en: He found Marcus's wallet in the glove compartment.
sentences.zh: 他在手套箱里找到了马库斯的钱包。

sentences.en: As he examined its contents, he noticed someone approaching the car.
sentences.zh: 当他检查里面的东西时，注意到有人正在靠近汽车。

sentences.en: A hunter was combing the edge of the forest when he spotted the light grey Mercedes parked up ahead.
sentences.zh: 一名猎人在森林边缘搜寻时，发现了前方停着的浅灰色奔驰车。

sentences.en: Somebody was standing nearby, acting nervously.
sentences.zh: 有人站在附近，举止紧张。

sentences.en: It was a small man wearing a leather hat and sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 那是一个戴着皮帽和太阳镜的小个子男人。

sentences.en: He then rushed to a red moped parked 5 metres away and sped off.
sentences.zh: 他随后冲向5米外停着的一辆红色轻便摩托车，飞驰而去。

sentences.en: The hunter reached the Mercedes and peered through its windows, finding the bodies of Marcus Adler and Ruth Lissy inside.
sentences.zh: 猎人走到奔驰车旁，透过车窗向内窥视，发现了车内马库斯·阿德勒和露丝·利西的遗体。

sentences.en: Shocked by the grisly discovery, the hunter fired his shotgun into the air to alert nearby hikers and farmers that help was needed.
sentences.zh: 被这恐怖的发现震惊后，猎人向空中鸣枪，提醒附近的徒步旅行者和农民需要帮助。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: Left with no other option, he was forced to trek one and a half kilometres to the nearest phone booth, where he contacted police.
sentences.zh: 别无选择，他被迫徒步走了一公里半到达最近的电话亭，联系了警察。

sentences.en: Post-mortems revealed that Marcus and Ruth's wounds had been sucked clean of blood.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，马库斯和露丝伤口处的血液被吮吸得干干净净。

sentences.en: The double homicide occurred less than 24 hours after the shooting of Georg Warmut and in the same city.
sentences.zh: 这起双重谋杀案发生在格奥尔格·瓦穆特枪击案不到24小时后，且在同一个城市。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if the two incidents were related.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑这两起事件是否有关联。

sentences.en: They compared the bullets retrieved from both crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 他们对比了从两个犯罪现场提取的子弹。

sentences.en: They were a perfect match.
sentences.zh: 结果完全吻合。

sentences.en: The head of Nuremberg's homicide squad called the disturbed perpetrator a madman.
sentences.zh: 纽伦堡凶杀组组长称这名丧心病狂的肇事者为疯子。

sentences.en: A task force was swiftly formed to hunt down the killer, while a 6,000 Deutsche Mark reward was offered for his capture.
sentences.zh: 警方迅速成立了专案组追捕凶手，并悬赏6000德国马克缉拿归案。

sentences.en: His physical description was published in newspapers, along with an alert for the public to be on the lookout for his distinctive red moped.
sentences.zh: 他的外貌特征被刊登在报纸上，并提醒公众留意他那辆显眼的红色轻便摩托车。

sentences.en: Helmut Kostan was employed with a transit company based in Nuremberg.
sentences.zh: 赫尔穆特·科斯坦受雇于纽伦堡的一家运输公司。

sentences.en: Four days after the Adler and Lissie slayings, Helmut picked up a copy of a local paper.
sentences.zh: 在阿德勒和利西遇害四天后，赫尔穆特买了一份当地报纸。

sentences.en: The blood-sucking, gun-wielding madman terrorising the city was still making headlines.
sentences.zh: 那个在城市里制造恐怖的嗜血持枪疯子依然占据着头条。

sentences.en: Helmut was struck by the suspect's description.
sentences.zh: 赫尔穆特被嫌疑人的描述所震惊。

sentences.en: It reminded him of his colleague, 41-year-old Kuno Hoffman.
sentences.zh: 这让他想起了他的同事，41岁的库诺·霍夫曼。

sentences.en: Hoffman was a short-statured, black-haired man who wore spectacles and drove a red moped.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼是一个身材矮小、留着黑发、戴着眼镜且骑红色轻便摩托车的男人。

sentences.en: Just minutes earlier, Hoffman had entered the manager's office and abruptly resigned from his job.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，霍夫曼走进经理办公室，突然辞职了。

sentences.en: He no longer wanted to work the docks loading boxes into trucks, instead expressing a desire to go to Hamburg.
sentences.zh: 他不想再在码头装卸货物，而是表达了想去汉堡的愿望。

sentences.en: Hoffman had just left when Helmut Kostan came across his description in the local paper in relation to the recent killings.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼刚走，赫尔穆特·科斯坦就在当地报纸上看到了关于近期杀人案的嫌疑人描述。

sentences.en: Helmut rushed to a phone and called the police.
sentences.zh: 赫尔穆特冲到电话旁报了警。

sentences.en: Kuno Hoffman was a troubled individual.
sentences.zh: 库诺·霍夫曼是一个问题人物。

sentences.en: Following his birth in 1931, he was violently beaten by his alcoholic father.
sentences.zh: 1931年出生后，他经常遭到酗酒父亲的暴力殴打。

sentences.en: At age one, Kuno's father shoved him into a sack and threw him away.
sentences.zh: 一岁时，库诺的父亲把他塞进麻袋里扔掉了。

sentences.en: On another occasion, young Kuno was hung from a wooden window frame and beaten.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，年幼的库诺被挂在木窗框上毒打。

sentences.en: Kuno's mother claimed the brutal physical abuse had caused Kuno to become deaf and non-verbal.
sentences.zh: 库诺的母亲声称，残酷的身体虐待导致库诺变得又聋又哑。

sentences.en: However, a doctor maintained that his permanent disabilities were the result of a middle ear infection.
sentences.zh: 然而，一位医生坚持认为他的永久性残疾是中耳炎造成的。

sentences.en: Kuno's father remained an inconsistent presence throughout his childhood, often spending long stints in prison.
sentences.zh: 库诺的父亲在库诺的童年时期一直是个不称职的父亲，经常长期入狱。

sentences.en: He served time for burglary, child abuse, and the attempted murder of a woman he had raped.
sentences.zh: 他曾因入室盗窃、虐待儿童以及企图谋杀一名被他强奸的女性而服刑。

sentences.en: When his father was home, Kuno isolated himself to avoid his wrath.
sentences.zh: 当父亲在家时，库诺会把自己隔离起来以躲避他的怒火。

sentences.en: His parents eventually divorced in 1940.
sentences.zh: 他的父母最终于1940年离婚。

sentences.en: Kuno moved between eight different schools for deaf children before taking on a shoemaker's apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 库诺在进入鞋匠学徒行当之前，曾辗转于八所不同的聋哑学校。

sentences.en: He gave up on that in a fit of rage, then took up work on an agricultural estate in Nuremberg.
sentences.zh: 后来他因一时冲动放弃了学徒工作，转而在纽伦堡的一处农场打工。

sentences.en: Although considered a diligent worker, Kuno lost his job when he demanded a higher wage.
sentences.zh: 尽管被认为工作勤奋，但库诺因要求涨薪而被解雇了。

sentences.en: With an IQ of 70 and the inability to communicate, options were limited for Kuno.
sentences.zh: 库诺的智商只有70，且无法进行交流，这使他的选择非常有限。

sentences.en: His life from there on out was interspersed with odd jobs and crime.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他的生活便与零工和犯罪交织在一起。

sentences.en: His first charge came in 1949 following the theft of a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 他第一次被指控是在1949年，起因是偷了一辆自行车。

sentences.en: By the 1950s, he was committing burglaries and arson.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪50年代，他开始犯下入室盗窃和纵火罪。

sentences.en: The courts tried to help Hoffman.
sentences.zh: 法院曾试图帮助霍夫曼。

sentences.en: He was placed into various medical and nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 他被送往多家医疗机构和疗养院。

sentences.en: But the silent man remained an enigma to physicians.
sentences.zh: 但这位沉默寡言的男人对医生来说始终是个谜。

sentences.en: In total, he spent nine years in nursing homes and another nine in prison.
sentences.zh: 他总共在疗养院度过了九年，又在监狱里度过了九年。

sentences.en: Sometimes, he accepted treatment willingly.
sentences.zh: 有时，他会欣然接受治疗。

sentences.en: Other times, not so much.
sentences.zh: 而有时，则没那么配合。

sentences.en: He exploited lax security measures in the homes where he was kept to escape on 12 occasions.
sentences.zh: 他利用所住机构松懈的安保措施，先后逃跑了12次。

sentences.en: By 1971, he had only spent five years of his adult life free of any type of incarceration.
sentences.zh: 到1971年时，他成年后的生活中只有五年是完全没有被监禁过的。

sentences.en: Hoffman went to live with his sister and brother in Nuremberg, where he picked up work.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼搬去与他在纽伦堡的兄弟姐妹同住，并在那里找了份工作。

sentences.en: For the first time in a long time, Kuno Hoffman's life seemed to be on track.
sentences.zh: 这是很久以来，库诺·霍夫曼的生活第一次看起来步入了正轨。

sentences.en: However, Hoffman was an unappealing man who was unable to form romantic relationships.
sentences.zh: 然而，霍夫曼是一个缺乏魅力且无法建立恋爱关系的男人。

sentences.en: He developed an addiction to pornography and took to visiting brothels in search of companionship.
sentences.zh: 他染上了色情成瘾，并开始光顾妓院以寻求陪伴。

sentences.en: Yet, he felt the sex workers only aimed to get the job done and was left bitter by their expressions of disgust whenever they were intimate with him.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得性工作者只是在完成工作，每当她们对他表现出厌恶时，他都会感到苦涩。

sentences.en: He desired to be loved tenderly and permanently.
sentences.zh: 他渴望得到温柔且长久的爱。

sentences.en: Over time, loneliness consumed him.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，孤独感吞噬了他。

sentences.en: At one stage, his sister told him to buy a rubber doll.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他的姐姐建议他买个充气娃娃。

sentences.en: But Hoffman was determined to find another way to improve his situation.
sentences.zh: 但霍夫曼决心寻找其他方法来改善自己的处境。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 支持我们的赞助商，就是支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Following the tip-off to police, six officers in four patrol cars quickly descended on Kuno Hoffman's workplace.
sentences.zh: 在接到警方线报后，四辆巡逻车上的六名警官迅速赶往库诺·霍夫曼的工作地点。

sentences.en: Although he matched the description of the shooter wanted in relation to the Adler-Lissy murders, his colleagues didn't actually believe Hoffman was responsible.
sentences.zh: 尽管他与阿德勒-利西谋杀案中通缉的枪手特征相符，但他的同事们并不相信霍夫曼是凶手。

sentences.en: He was, by their accounts, a harmless guy.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，他是个无害的人。

sentences.en: When police came looking for him, they discovered Hoffman had since left the premises.
sentences.zh: 当警察来找他时，发现霍夫曼已经离开了现场。

sentences.en: A search commenced and, by chance, he was spotted hiding behind a truck.
sentences.zh: 搜捕行动随即展开，偶然间，有人发现他躲在一辆卡车后面。

sentences.en: He took off, but was quickly apprehended.
sentences.zh: 他试图逃跑，但很快被捕获。

sentences.en: Police would come to discover that Kuno Hoffman was deaf and non-verbal and communicated using noiseless facial expressions and hand gestures.
sentences.zh: 警方随后发现库诺·霍夫曼是聋哑人，无法说话，通过无声的面部表情和手势进行交流。

sentences.en: As such, an interpreter was summoned to facilitate communications between him and homicide detectives.
sentences.zh: 因此，警方传唤了一名翻译，以协助他与凶杀案调查组的侦探进行沟通。

sentences.en: The interview began at 6pm, to enable more time for evidence gathering.
sentences.zh: 审讯于下午6点开始，以便有更多时间收集证据。

sentences.en: The interpreter spoke on Hoffman's behalf and his answers were recorded.
sentences.zh: 翻译代表霍夫曼发言，他的回答都被记录了下来。

sentences.en: Throughout the 50-minute interrogation, Hoffman was caught lying and his version of events were contradictory.
sentences.zh: 在长达50分钟的审讯中，霍夫曼多次被揭穿谎言，他的供词前后矛盾。

sentences.en: At one stage, police threatened Hoffman with a crowbar to get him to confess to the murders.
sentences.zh: 有一次，警察用撬棍威胁霍夫曼，试图让他承认谋杀罪行。

sentences.en: Yet, he only admitted to things he wanted to.
sentences.zh: 然而，他只承认了他想承认的事情。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Hoffman's room at the home he shared with his sister and brother was being searched.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，霍夫曼与兄弟姐妹合住的房间正在接受搜查。

sentences.en: His red moped was found at the address, along with Ruth Lissy's engagement ring.
sentences.zh: 警方在该地址发现了他的红色轻便摩托车，以及露丝·利西的订婚戒指。

sentences.en: The human skull that had been cut from a corpse in Moulin Cemetery was also amongst Hoffman's
sentences.zh: 从穆兰公墓的一具尸体上割下的人类头骨也在霍夫曼的

sentences.en: possessions, as were a set of duplicate keys to the Vestfriedhof mortuary and other items stolen from the crematorium.
sentences.zh: 物品中被发现，此外还有西公墓太平间的备用钥匙以及从火葬场偷来的其他物品。

sentences.en: However, the murder weapon was still missing.
sentences.zh: 然而，凶器仍未找到。

sentences.en: Shortly before 9pm, an officer examining Hoffman's washing machine began unscrewing the appliance piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点前不久，一名检查霍夫曼洗衣机的警官开始将设备拆解开来。

sentences.en: Hidden within, he discovered a 7.65mm pistol.
sentences.zh: 他在里面发现了一把7.65毫米口径的手枪。

sentences.en: He contacted the detectives interviewing Hoffman to inform them of the discovery.
sentences.zh: 他联系了正在审讯霍夫曼的侦探，告知了这一发现。

sentences.en: When Hoffman was told of the find, his face twitched and lips trembled.
sentences.zh: 当霍夫曼被告知这一发现时，他的脸抽搐了一下，嘴唇颤抖起来。

sentences.en: He then began to motion with his hands.
sentences.zh: 随后他开始用手比划。

sentences.en: Over the next 20 minutes, he provided investigators with a confession.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的20分钟里，他向调查人员供述了罪行。

sentences.en: Hoffman read extensively and, in 1966, purchased a book titled The Black Magic by an occultist group in Hamburg.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼阅读广泛，1966年，他购买了一本由汉堡一个神秘学团体编写的名为《黑魔法》的书。

sentences.en: The text fostered what would become a lifelong fascination of the dark arts.
sentences.zh: 这本书培养了他对黑暗艺术终身的迷恋。

sentences.en: Hoffman read up on various occult subjects like Satanism and soon harboured an obsession to self-improve using their teachings.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼阅读了各种关于撒旦教等神秘学主题的书籍，并很快沉迷于利用这些教义来“自我提升”。

sentences.en: He became infatuated by two particularly taboo subgroups, vampirism and necrophilia, the sexual attraction to, or sexual acts involving corpses.
sentences.zh: 他迷上了两个特别禁忌的亚群体：吸血鬼崇拜和恋尸癖，即对尸体的性吸引或涉及尸体的性行为。

sentences.en: Between 1971 and 72, Hoffman forced entry into cemeteries and mortuaries throughout Germany.
sentences.zh: 1971年至1972年间，霍夫曼强行闯入德国各地的墓地和太平间。

sentences.en: He stole and duplicated building keys so he could move in and out with ease.
sentences.zh: 他偷窃并复制了建筑钥匙，以便能轻松出入。

sentences.en: Under the cover of darkness, he dug up fresh graves or entered crematoriums and began violating the deceased.
sentences.zh: 在夜幕的掩护下，他挖掘新坟或进入火葬场，开始亵渎死者。

sentences.en: He stabbed them with knives and razors and drank their blood.
sentences.zh: 他用刀和剃须刀刺伤他们，并饮用他们的血液。

sentences.en: Occasionally, he'd chew their flesh, cut off their heads, remove their hearts, or examine their internal organs.
sentences.zh: 有时，他会咀嚼他们的肉，割下他们的头，取出他们的心脏，或检查他们的内脏。

sentences.en: Sometimes, he'd manipulate several bodies at a single scene, posing them around each other.
sentences.zh: 有时，他会在同一个现场摆弄多具尸体，将它们摆出各种姿势。

sentences.en: He'd also sexually interfere with the bodies of women he found attractive.
sentences.zh: 他还会对那些他认为有吸引力的女性尸体进行性侵犯。

sentences.en: He travelled to each location on his red moped.
sentences.zh: 他骑着那辆红色轻便摩托车前往每一个地点。

sentences.en: By May 1972, Hoffman had desecrated the remains of 35 individuals.
sentences.zh: 到1972年5月，霍夫曼已经亵渎了35具遗体。

sentences.en: Obituary notices published in newspapers helped him choose his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 报纸上刊登的讣告帮助他选择了受害者。

sentences.en: At one stage, his brother suspected he was up to something.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他的兄弟怀疑他在搞什么鬼。

sentences.en: He articulated to Hoffman,
sentences.zh: 他质问霍夫曼，

sentences.en: Hoffman did not respond, but the accusation made him increasingly cautious.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼没有回应，但这次指责让他变得更加谨慎。

sentences.en: Hoffman believed that by carrying out his black magic rituals and consuming the blood of his victims, he would become handsome and strong.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼相信，通过进行黑魔法仪式并饮用受害者的血液，他会变得英俊强壮。

sentences.en: He also thought it would give him back his hearing and voice.
sentences.zh: 他还认为这能让他恢复听力和声音。

sentences.en: Only then would he have power over women.
sentences.zh: 只有那样，他才能掌控女性。

sentences.en: In the meantime, he had to impose his will on others through other means.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他必须通过其他方式将自己的意志强加于人。

sentences.en: He developed a fascination with pistols and rifles, which led to the purchase of a 7.65mm pistol for 500 Deutsche Marks.
sentences.zh: 他开始迷恋手枪和步枪，这导致他花了500德国马克买了一把7.65毫米口径的手枪。

sentences.en: Hoffman had made duplicate keys to the Westfriedhof mortuary and entered the premises on four occasions to steal valuables from the bodies stored there.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼复制了西公墓太平间的钥匙，并四次进入该场所，从存放的尸体上窃取贵重物品。

sentences.en: He intended to do so again on the night of May 5, 1972.
sentences.zh: 1972年5月5日晚，他打算再次作案。

sentences.en: However, once inside, his plans changed.
sentences.zh: 然而，进入后，他的计划改变了。

sentences.en: He wanted a pretty girl whose blood he could drink.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个漂亮的女孩，好喝她的血。

sentences.en: Hoffman was already in the morgue when Georg Varmut entered.
sentences.zh: 当格奥尔格·瓦穆特进入太平间时，霍夫曼已经在里面了。

sentences.en: But because he was deaf, Hoffman did not hear the night watchman approach.
sentences.zh: 但因为他是聋子，霍夫曼没有听到守夜人的靠近。

sentences.en: Startled, he rushed to the exit.
sentences.zh: 受惊之下，他冲向出口。

sentences.en: Hoffman pulled out his pistol on the way and shot Georg to facilitate his escape.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼在途中掏出手枪，射杀了格奥尔格以便逃脱。

sentences.en: Once outside, he scrambled over the wooden fence surrounding the cemetery and climbed onto his red moped that he had hidden in nearby shrubbery.
sentences.zh: 来到外面后，他翻过墓地周围的木栅栏，爬上他藏在附近灌木丛中的红色轻便摩托车。

sentences.en: He then took off home.
sentences.zh: 随后他逃回了家。

sentences.en: At nine the following morning, Hoffman rode his moped to the forest east of Nuremberg, where he hid for the duration of the day.
sentences.zh: 次日上午九点，霍夫曼骑着摩托车前往纽伦堡东部的森林，在那里躲了一整天。

sentences.en: That evening, he came across Marcus Adler and Ruth Lissy.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他遇到了马库斯·阿德勒和露丝·利西。

sentences.en: He killed the couple and consumed their blood, telling detectives that the pretty young girl had been much better than the women in the graveyards.
sentences.zh: 他杀害了这对夫妇并饮用了他们的血，并告诉侦探，这个漂亮的年轻女孩比墓地里的那些女人好得多。

sentences.en: As the passerby had seen him and his distinct vehicle,
sentences.zh: 由于路人看到了他和那辆显眼的交通工具，

sentences.en: Hoffman believed the police would track him down easily.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼认为警察会很容易追踪到他。

sentences.en: He hid his pistol in his washing machine and promptly quit his job, hoping to flee the city before authorities caught up with him.
sentences.zh: 他把手枪藏在洗衣机里，并迅速辞职，希望在当局抓到他之前逃离这座城市。

sentences.en: Hoffman's former employers were shocked by his actions.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼的前雇主们对他的行为感到震惊。

sentences.en: They issued a statement that described Hoffman as a nice person and questioned how the unassuming man could be capable of carrying out such horrendous acts.
sentences.zh: 他们发表声明称霍夫曼是个好人，并质疑这个谦逊的男人怎么可能做出如此可怕的行径。

sentences.en: Their character references were overwhelmingly positive.
sentences.zh: 他们的品行证明书几乎是一边倒的好评。

sentences.en: Hoffman hid his true nature well.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼很好地隐藏了自己的本性。

sentences.en: This indicated that he was capable of maintaining a double life and in complete control of his behaviour.
sentences.zh: 这表明他有能力维持双重生活，并能完全控制自己的行为。

sentences.en: Realising that his sanity would play a major role in his punishment,
sentences.zh: 意识到他的精神状态将在量刑中起重要作用，

sentences.en: Hoffman changed tactics.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼改变了策略。

sentences.en: He smashed the furniture in his cell and began writing bizarre letters.
sentences.zh: 他砸坏了牢房里的家具，开始写一些奇怪的信件。

sentences.en: In one addressed to the homicide squad, he claimed to have two times the amount of victims as Martin Rojak, a serial killer in the late 1500s.
sentences.zh: 在写给凶杀案调查组的一封信中，他声称自己的受害者人数是16世纪末连环杀手马丁·罗亚克的两倍。

sentences.en: Rojak is believed to have the highest number of victims in the Czech lands, allegedly killing over 59 people in a four-year span.
sentences.zh: 据信，罗亚克是捷克地区受害者人数最多的杀手，据称在四年内杀害了超过59人。

sentences.en: Hoffman also claimed to be innocent like Vera Brunner, a woman famous throughout Germany as a victim of miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼还声称自己像维拉·布鲁纳一样无辜，后者是德国著名的冤假错案受害者。

sentences.en: He also claimed he was the nephew of the British Queen, a member of a West German far-left militant organisation Red Army faction,
sentences.zh: 他还声称自己是英国女王的侄子，是西德极左武装组织“红军派”的成员，

sentences.en: and penned a letter to the Pope requesting admission into the strictest order of the Catholic Church.
sentences.zh: 并写信给教皇，请求加入天主教会最严格的修会。

sentences.en: He painted his cell walls with threats, including one that read,
sentences.zh: 他在牢房墙壁上写下威胁的话语，其中一条写道：

sentences.en: He demanded his murder weapon be returned so he could use it to bring the dead back to life.
sentences.zh: 他要求归还他的凶器，以便他能用它让死者复活。

sentences.en: Hoffman first appeared in court in August 1974.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼于1974年8月首次出庭。

sentences.en: The building was packed with onlookers, as Hoffman, via sign language, tried to explain his motive.
sentences.zh: 法庭挤满了围观者，霍夫曼通过手语试图解释他的动机。

sentences.en: He detailed his extreme loneliness, alienation, and isolation, and how that impacted his ability to have intimate relationships.
sentences.zh: 他详细描述了自己的极度孤独、疏离和孤立，以及这些感受如何影响了他建立亲密关系的能力。

sentences.en: These feelings then led him to commit the appalling acts.
sentences.zh: 这些感受随后导致他犯下了那些骇人听闻的罪行。

sentences.en: The defence argued that Hoffman was insane, but the prosecution thought differently.
sentences.zh: 辩方辩称霍夫曼精神失常，但检方持不同意见。

sentences.en: It was the court's role to decide whether he should face trial for murder or be judged unfit to plead and face confinement in a mental health facility.
sentences.zh: 法院的任务是决定他应该因谋杀罪受审，还是被判定不具备受审能力，并被关进精神卫生机构。

sentences.en: Two psychiatrists who had studied Kuno Hoffman appeared in court.
sentences.zh: 两名研究过库诺·霍夫曼的精神科医生出庭作证。

sentences.en: The first believed that the accused had lost touch with the world around him and was unfit to stand trial.
sentences.zh: 第一位医生认为被告已经与周围的世界失去了联系，不具备受审能力。

sentences.en: The trial judge suspended court proceedings for two years as psychiatric experts debated over Hoffman's sanity.
sentences.zh: 审判法官将庭审程序暂停了两年，以便精神病学专家对霍夫曼的精神状态进行辩论。

sentences.en: During this time,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，

sentences.en: Hoffman was moved between specialist clinics and psychiatric wards where his psychosis was examined and treated.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼在专业诊所和精神病房之间转移，他的精神病症状得到了检查和治疗。

sentences.en: When he returned to court in July 1976, he appeared well, though his recollections of his crimes remained inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 当他于1976年7月回到法庭时，他看起来状态良好，尽管他对犯罪过程的回忆仍然前后不一。

sentences.en: He claimed he acted in self-defence in both the Westfriedhof mortuary and the Nuremberg Forest shootings.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己在西公墓太平间和纽伦堡森林的枪击事件中都是出于自卫。

sentences.en: He alleged that Marcus Adler had surprised him while he was practising shooting in the woods and knocked the gun out of his hand.
sentences.zh: 他辩称马库斯·阿德勒在他于树林中练习射击时突然出现，并打掉了他手中的枪。

sentences.en: Following this assertion, questions were once again raised as to Hoffman's mental stability.
sentences.zh: 这一说法提出后，人们再次对霍夫曼的精神稳定性提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Depending on the source,
sentences.zh: 根据来源不同，

sentences.en: Kuno Hoffman's outcome varies.
sentences.zh: 库诺·霍夫曼的结局各不相同。

sentences.en: Some report that he never faced a full trial after being deemed criminally insane.
sentences.zh: 一些报道称，他在被认定患有精神疾病后从未接受过全面审判。

sentences.en: This version ends with his indefinite detainment in a mental health facility.
sentences.zh: 这个版本的结局是他被无限期关押在精神卫生机构中。

sentences.en: Other, more reliable sources state that he was ruled sane and faced court for at least the shooting attacks.
sentences.zh: 其他更可靠的来源称，他被判定精神正常，并至少就枪击事件接受了法庭审判。

sentences.en: They claim that Hoffman, described by the trial judge as a pitiful human being, was sentenced to two life sentences for the murders of Marcus Adler and Ruth Lissi,
sentences.zh: 他们声称，被审判法官描述为“可怜虫”的霍夫曼，因谋杀马库斯·阿德勒和露丝·利西被判处两次终身监禁，

sentences.en: with an additional 10 years for the attempted murder of Georg Warmut.
sentences.zh: 并因谋杀未遂格奥尔格·瓦穆特被额外判处10年监禁。

sentences.en: While awaiting transfer to a federal penitentiary, he taunted jailers, requesting one final sip of a virgin's blood.
sentences.zh: 在等待转移到联邦监狱时，他嘲弄狱卒，要求最后再喝一口处女的血。

sentences.en: There have also been reports that Hoffman was released in 2004 for reasons, if true, we couldn't ascertain.
sentences.zh: 还有报道称霍夫曼于2004年获释，原因不明，如果属实，我们无法核实。

sentences.en: This ending has Hoffman returning to Nuremberg to live.
sentences.zh: 这个结局是霍夫曼回到了纽伦堡居住。

sentences.en: These sources state that in 2008, the now 75-year-old was working on a memoir, though the status of the work is unclear.
sentences.zh: 这些来源称，2008年时，这位75岁的老人正在撰写回忆录，但该作品的进展情况尚不清楚。

sentences.en: Should you believe this to be the true ending to Kuno Hoffman's story, it is important to note that no one knows where he is today.
sentences.zh: 如果您认为这是库诺·霍夫曼故事的真实结局，需要注意的是，没人知道他今天在哪里。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
